title: ui-baseline.json
description: DOM references to a never-allowed host that the product's UI rendered before the Ever Platform modules existed (a footer link, a documentation link), written once and allowed to shrink only (check-baseline-shrink). An entry excuses the same {route, attribute, url} in the DOM check and nothing else: never a DNS query, a connection attempt, a HAR entry or a request.

route.description: The route of ui-routes.json the reference was found on, or (sign-in).

url.description: As dom-refs.json writes it (query values dropped).
